scope: Directional balance/manual falls, fewer knee-only recoveries, finite rise rebound through free control.
changes: Capture the live balance needle and manual type before cancellation. Apply world-space spin in the lost-balance direction, independent of heading and skate stance.
Manual body drift and board release oppose one another: backward manual sends the deck forward; forward nose-manual fall sends it backward. Use the existing finite discarded-board solver.

Reserve 0.46 seconds for a balance fall and 0.32 seconds for other intact falls. Recovery still requires stable support and its existing velocity/timer condition. Cosmetic orientation and support seating do not determine controller recovery time.
Let the body topple around its initial contact with bounded scalar substeps and reduced initial angular friction; retain the 16 rad/s cap. No extra world queries or linear controller torque.

Release the two-knee tuck as the torso rises. Add a finite 0.95-second segment rebound that begins late in recovery and continues after controls return, using the shared editable bail elasticity profile.
Reuse the rise deformation record; no whole-skeleton scaling or per-frame records. Preserve normal interaction-bound policy after controls return.
Extend the lab to 17 bail cases, add Fall and Rise rebound stops, and clear debris between isolated lab incidents.
